workload: 8 fixed prompts, concurrency=8, 32 output tokens, 5 measured rounds after warmup; --enforce-eager --mamba-cache-mode align

operator_microbenchmark.result: cache direct kernel was 4.5%-6.8% slower than the out-of-place T1 kernel for B=1-64; it also omits gather/store overhead, so this is not a full service A/B.

conclusion: Rejected and reverted. Direct cache update regressed service TPS by -29.54% and violated deterministic token parity. Do not enable RWKV7_USE_FUSED_RECURRENT_T1_CACHE; cache row ownership / decode state indexing requires a smaller, isolated reproduction before another attempt.
